conventions.model: theta_{k,s} = theta_k + rho_k(s); rho_k(s) = rho_max_k (1 - exp(-(s - 1) / tau))
conventions.gain: computed as -rho_max * expm1(-(s - 1) / tau); exactly 0 at s = 1
conventions.test_number: s for axis k in a session = 1 + the number of earlier sittings (time order) that took axis k: a sitting took k when one of its sessions has at least one observation on k or k in its exposed_axes; only axes a session took get an entry. Without continuations every session is its own sitting
conventions.exposed_axes: optional per input session: axis codes it presented items on that gave no observation (pretest, unregenerable, unscored); any order, repeats ignored
conventions.continuation: optional per input session (true): the session continues the sitting of the session just before it in session_order; ignored on the first session. A sitting is a session and the continuations that follow it; its sessions share its test numbers. outputs.sessions carry continuation: true exactly for the sessions that continue a sitting
conventions.score: one MAP/Laplace + per-axis EAP over every session's adjusted observations (scoring_v1 conventions) under N(mu, sigma); mu defaults to 0, sigma to the pinned initial Sigma (sigma_version); log_posterior_at_map is that of the adjusted observations
conventions.next_prior: mu_k = theta_map_k + gain(rho_max_k, next_ordinals_k); covariance = cov

cases.description: No sessions: the population prior; every next test number is 1.
One session: s = 1 everywhere, rho = 0, the plain scoring posterior.
The same MAT responses twice: the second test's items are shifted by rho(2).
MAT in sessions 1 and 3 only (test numbers 1, 2); KST in sessions 2 and 3 (1, 2).
Sessions listed out of time order, two with the same start time (ordered by id); the latest has the smallest id, so ordering by id alone fails.
2PL, 3PL, GRM and Gaussian (RT lambda < 0, PS lambda > 0) over three sessions.
rho_max = 0 on every axis: the sessions are pooled as one.
Own rho_max for some axes (one negative, a fatigue-like loss); the rest the prior.
Own prior mean and covariance with two sessions of mixed terms.
MAT on ten sessions: test numbers 1..10, the gain approaches rho_max.
Session 1 took SPA and WM but none of it scored (pretest, unregenerable ids): SPA in session 2 is test 2, and KST exposed in session 2 is test 1 there, 2 in session 3.
exposed_axes repeating an observed axis (and itself) count the session once.
s_2 continues s_1 (one sitting): SPA in both parts and MAT, KST, RT in one are all test 1; s_3 is a new sitting, test 2 on every axis.
s_1 exposed WM; its continuation s_2 scored nothing and exposed PS and WM: both stay test 1 in the sitting, and s_3 is test 2 on MAT, WM and PS.
KST skipped in the second sitting (s_2 and its continuation s_3): s_4 is test 3 on MAT, 2 on KST and SPA.
s_1, s_2 and s_3 are one sitting (test 1 on MAT, SPA, RT); s_4 starts the second (test 2) and s_5 continues it.
The first session's continuation mark is ignored (no continuation in the output): it is test 1 and s_2 test 2.
Listed out of time order; s_a and s_b share a start time, so s_b (later by id) continues s_a, and s_z continues s_b: QR is test 1 in s_0 and 2 in the rest.
